Changes: only the promotional media was removed (test_vfi_schedule.gif, demo_frames\, All_in_one_v1_3.png). The code is unchanged.
The RIFE weights (ckpts\rife\rife49.pth) come with the models (setup\download-models.mjs); the node also fetches them on first use.
Setup (setup\setup.ps1) copies this folder into ComfyUI_windows_portable\ComfyUI\custom_nodes\.

Note: the upstream .gitignore was removed (it ignored files in this repository).
